title: The Palm Tree of Deborah (Tomer Devorah)
author: Moses Cordovero (Nataf trans)
description: Moses Cordovero connects Kabbalistic teaching with ethical life, presenting divine attributes as qualities to be reflected in human conduct. This translation introduces a practical account of compassion, patience and spiritual character.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from Sefaria (https://www.sefaria.org/Tomer_Devorah).
